|gr1= GUI Control - ListNBox

|descr= Returns size of [[CT_LISTNBOX]]. This command supports [[CT_TOOLBOX]] control since Arma 3 v2.06. For [[CT_COMBO]] or [[CT_LISTBOX]] see [[lbSize]].

|s1= [[lnbSize]] controlOrIDC

|p1= controlOrIDC: [[Control]] or [[Number]] - control or control's IDC

|r1= [[Array]] - in format [rows, columns]
* rows: [[Number]] - Number of rows
* columns: [[Number]] - Number of columns

|x1= <sqf>lnbSize _control;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>lnbSize _someIDC;</sqf>
